metadata.siteName: Site E-2, Anderson Road Quarry — 30-classroom Primary School (Project 8591)

clusters.name: School Building — Learning and Assembly
clusters.rationale: The main school block, assembly hall, and classroom cluster form a single building bubble. Hall and classroom cluster are contained within the GF building per input. GF footprint ~2,500 m2 on 7,031 m2 site = 35.56% gross site area.

clusters.name: Outdoor Activity — Basketball Courts
clusters.rationale: Two basketball courts long-edge-to-long-edge (36m x 48m = 1,728 m2) form primary outdoor social space. 1728/7031 = 24.58% gross site area.

clusters.name: Vehicular and Service Cluster
clusters.rationale: Loading/unloading, daily access road, and internal EVA road share one operational cluster near the vehicular entrance. Estimated road/service area ~400 m2 = 5.69% gross. EVA is internal (b.evaint=True).

adjacencies.rationale: School building should be adjacent to outdoor courts to maximize building-edge interface with social open space and student access.
Assembly hall requires proximity to loading/unloading for servicing; EVA road must serve the building facade.
Outdoor activity area requires vehicle access for maintenance; loading must not conflict with court use.
Vehicular service cluster originates from the fixed vehicular entrance gate near J(6.244, -66.544).
School building must remain outside the public street boundary; setback from NW street face required.
Vehicular and service cluster must be accessible from the NW street frontage where the vehicular entrance is located.
School building main entrance should be near the pedestrian gate at (-1.239, -47.309) for direct access from street.

relationships.rationale: Assembly hall is a component within the school building block; they share a direct physical interface at the GF level.
Classroom cluster is a component within the school building block; they share a direct physical interface across upper floors.
Assembly hall is contained within the GF school building footprint per input containment relationship.
Classroom cluster is contained within the GF school building footprint per input containment relationship.
Building footprint should be adjacent to basketball courts to maximize shared-edge interface and student access to social open space (R_0008).
Hall should lean toward the vehicular entrance edge (R_0009). Hall at SW arm of L-shape building is nearest the vehicular entrance near J.
Hall should be adjacent to loading/unloading for school servicing efficiency (R_0041).
Classroom clusters must be placed away from vehicular entrances and public roads (R_0004). Classrooms should not face the 20m NW public street.
Internal EVA road must serve at least 25% of building facade perimeter within 10m (R_0024). EVA is internal with no street EVA (b.evastreet=0, b.evaint=True).
Daily vehicular road connects directly to the vehicular entrance gate.
Loading/unloading space must be accessible from the daily vehicular road.
Internal EVA road shares the same vehicular access network as the daily road; they must connect at the site entry point.
Basketball courts should be accessible and visible from the pedestrian entrance area for school community connectivity.
Classroom cluster corridor side should directly face the outdoor courts (R_0004 priority 2-3 placement, R_0008 coupled-placement principle). Confirms BUB02 interface with classroom wing.
